heading: AI plan
description: What your AI plan covers this period. The plan is managed by {{brand}}; contact them to change it.
none: This institute has no AI plan. Every AI use is charged from credits.

allowance.title: Monthly allowance
allowance.hint: Pays for features marked “From allowance”. Once it runs out they use credits. Unused allowance does not roll over.
allowance.none: This plan has no monthly allowance.

INCLUDED.title: Included in your plan
INCLUDED.description: No credits are used, within fair use. Past a fair-use limit, or with a model outside the plan, the use is charged from credits.

ALLOWANCE.title: Paid from the plan allowance
ALLOWANCE.description: Drawn from this period's allowance first, then from credits.

CHARGED.title: Uses credits
CHARGED.description: Charged from your credits as usual.

fairUse.used: {{pct}}% of fair use used this period
fairUse.reached: Fair-use limit reached: further uses are charged from credits until the next period.
